elaine_fin: ResellerCloud reported April payout shortfall — 5 reserved-instance credits not applied to RW-2026-04. Can billing confirm?

marc_billing: pulling marketplace report and our import. give me 5.

derek_partners: partner pasted this into portal: `sku,usage_date,units,credit_type
redwood-inference.reserved,2026-04-10,5,reservationCredit` they say this matches docs.

deploy-bot: deploy: billing-ingest v2.9.0 deployed 2026-04-11T01:05:12Z.

marc_billing: raw marketplace file includes the row but our ingestion log shows "skipped: unknown_credit_type". It looks like our enum expects `reservation_credit` (underscore).

elaine_fin: what's the dollar impact?

marc_billing: unit credit = $1,150. 5 * 1,150 = $5,750.

yvonne_treasury: pre-approve provisional credit of $5,750 pending backfill. Send FIN ticket once ready.

derek_partners: partner prefers not to reformat CSVs. please fix on our side.

marc_billing: plan: (1) apply one-time adjustment credit $5,750 and tag "partner reconciliation", (2) backfill ledger import using tolerant mapping, (3) patch v2.9.1 to normalize credit_type variants and add unit tests, (4) add alert when ingestion drops >0 credit rows.

elaine_fin: agree. marc, create the credit note and attach to FIN-3512. Add GL entries: debit 4302, credit 4010.

marc_billing: credit note drafted and attached to FIN-3512. Backfill run completed: s3://redwood-billing/backfills/2026-04-10-resellercloud.csv import id imp-2026-04-11-1122.

yvonne_treasury: scheduled for next AP run. marking FIN-3512 approved for payment.

derek_partners: partner confirmed their accounting agrees after our adjustment. thanks.

elaine_fin: RCA in FIN-3512: ingestion v2.9.0 tightened enum validation; hyphen/underscore/camel variants for credit_type were rejected. Remediation: applied credit, backfilled ledger, deployed tolerant normalization in v2.9.1, added integration test and monitoring.

marc_billing: closing once payment posts.

elaine_fin: leaving thread open until AP confirms payment posted.
